facts.fact: SIREC's own About page describes it as the platform for registering civil-status acts, naming birth, acknowledgement of paternity, marriage and death; the page is undated and says nothing of which offices use it, so the proxy publication date is used.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registo e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

facts.fact: SIREC's About page says the system creates, updates, stores and consults civil registration information in a single integrated database, with wholly digital storage of acts; this is the system's stated design on an undated standing page, not a report of offices entering events, and the proxy publication date is used.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registo e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

facts.fact: SIREC's About page says the system was implemented by the Direção-Geral de Identificação Civil, Registos e Notariado, in partnership with Portugal's Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado and the Universidade de Aveiro; undated page, proxy publication date used.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registo e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

facts.fact: SIREC's About page says the system was financed by the European Union under the GESTDOC project, managed by Camões, I.P.; no domestic funding is mentioned, and the proxy publication date is used.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registo e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)
